limitations: Deterministic synthetic 8192-entry vocabulary, five grammar cases and three modes; not the full 9558-schema corpus or real model inference.
Per-run percentiles are retained; comparison uses the median of six trial statistics, not a pooled distribution or formal significance test.
Each trial has five warm compilation and seven warm-link samples; descriptive lifecycle measurements, not build/link tail certification.
Both versions use identical release defaults, toolchain and registry dependencies; only API source spelling/preparation name differs.
Canonical forcing is tested for correctness separately, not compared for probability-preserving semantics.
macOS native only; no claim that final Windows binaries were built after the requested migration.
